title: Bugfix
description: Reproduce a bug, fix the root cause in a worktree, and prove it with a test.

nodes.title: Reproduce
nodes.prompt:
Reproduce this bug and find its root cause: {{input:bug}}

List every caller of the code at fault. Do not edit files yet.

nodes.title: Fix
nodes.prompt:
Fix the root cause of: {{input:bug}}

Add a test that fails without the fix.
